data: Is the blue line always higher than the red line for the BioASQ4 test set?

The blue line represents the average micro f-measure of all the participating systems, while the red line represents the best performing system's micro f-measure. In the BioASQ4 test set, the blue line (average) is consistently lower than the red line (best performing). Therefore, the blue line is not always higher than the red line for the BioASQ4 test set.
